repos_data.description: Cloud FinOps Skill & MCP by OptimNow. FinOps Foundation aligned knowledge for AI agents: cloud cost (AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI), AI inference economics, Kubernetes, data platforms, allocation, chargeback, anomaly management, waste detection, GreenOps. Installs into 12 AI tools, or connect the hosted MCP server by URL. Refreshed weekly.

Detects structural waste in cloud billing exports (AWS/GCP/Azure) using rolling-median + MAD, robust to the masking effect that breaks mean+stddev anomaly detection. Python library, CLI, FastAPI service, and GitHub Action.
